status: DRAFT -- pending Legal Lead approval. Written by engineering from the section headings and text in corpus/companies_act on 2026-11-01. Not reviewed by a lawyer. These change which sections an answer cites; they never change what a section says.
note: Two kinds of hint, both read by checker/text_search.py. `words`: a question word the Act's headings never use, and the heading word it means; the added word is shown to the reader exactly like an abbreviation expansion. `topics`: when every `all` pattern matches the question and no `none` pattern does, the listed sections are moved up the ranking. A topic hint only REORDERS what the search already found -- it never admits a section that did not clear the search's own floors, so it cannot turn silence into a guess. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. Every section number here is asserted to exist in corpus/companies_act/_index.json by checker/text_search.py's self-test. Abbreviations (AGM, EGM, RPT, KMP ...) live in checker/abbrev.json, not here.
